description: This file defines the MainPage class for a calculator application, implementing the main user interface logic, navigation, event handling, and view management for different calculator modes and features.

classes.name: MainPage
classes.description: MainPage class manages the primary user interface of the calculator app, handling navigation, mode switching, event registration, and accessibility features.

methods.name: UnregisterEventHandlers
methods.description: Unregisters event handlers for window size changes and high contrast changes, and unregisters calculator event handlers.

methods.name: SetDefaultFocus
methods.description: Sets focus to the default UI element based on current visibility of calculator components.

methods.name: SetHeaderAutomationName
methods.description: Sets the automation name for the header based on current mode for accessibility.

methods.name: OnNavigatedTo
methods.description: Handles navigation to the page, initializing mode based on saved settings or parameters.

methods.name: InitializeNavViewCategoriesSource
methods.description: Initializes the navigation view categories source list.

methods.name: ExpandNavViewCategoryGroups
methods.description: Expands category groups into a flat list for navigation.

methods.name: UpdatePopupSize
methods.description: Updates the size of the popup content to match window size.

methods.name: WindowSizeChanged
methods.description: Handles window size changes, updating view state and popup size.

methods.name: OnAppPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in application view model properties, updating UI and controls accordingly.

methods.name: SelectNavigationItemByModel
methods.description: Selects the navigation item corresponding to the current model mode.

methods.name: OnNavLoaded
methods.description: Handles navigation view loaded event, setting up accelerators and default selection.

methods.name: OnNavPaneOpened
methods.description: Handles event when navigation pane is opened, disabling shortcuts.

methods.name: OnNavPaneClosed
methods.description: Handles event when navigation pane is closed, restoring shortcuts and focus.

methods.name: EnsurePopupContent
methods.description: Ensures the popup content element exists and is sized correctly.

methods.name: ShowSettingsPopup
methods.description: Displays the settings popup.

methods.name: CloseSettingsPopup
methods.description: Closes the settings popup and resets focus.

methods.name: ShowSnapshotLaunchErrorAsync
methods.description: Displays an error dialog if snapshot restore fails.

methods.name: EnsureCalculator
methods.description: Lazily initializes the calculator control and binds properties.

methods.name: EnsureDateCalculator
methods.description: Lazily initializes the date calculator control.

methods.name: EnsureGraphingCalculator
methods.description: Lazily initializes the graphing calculator control.

methods.name: EnsureConverter
methods.description: Lazily initializes the unit converter control.

methods.name: AnnounceCategoryName
methods.description: Announces the current category name for accessibility.

methods.name: ShouldShowBackButton
methods.description: Determines whether to show the back button based on mode and popup state.

methods.name: NavigationViewOpenPaneLength
methods.description: Returns the open pane length for the navigation view based on mode.

methods.name: DoubleToGridLength
methods.description: Converts a double value to GridLength.

methods.name: Settings_BackButtonClick
methods.description: Handles back button click in settings popup.
